prompt: how to change a flat tire

plan.title: How to Change a Flat Tire Safely
plan.description: Learn how to change a flat tire step by step, from getting to safety to tightening the lug nuts. A calm, practical guide anyone can follow on the side of the road.

beats.narration: A flat tire can happen anywhere, and most people never practice. The good news is that you can fix it in about twenty minutes, with just a few tools and a clear plan.
First, find a safe place. Pull over on flat, firm ground, away from traffic. Turn on your hazard lights, put the car in park, and set the parking brake.

steps.label: Pull over on flat, firm ground
Park and set the parking brake

beats.narration: Next, gather your tools. You need a spare tire, a jack, and a lug wrench. Your owner's manual shows where they are stored and where the jack fits.
Before lifting anything, loosen the lug nuts. Turn the wrench counterclockwise, just a half turn each. The tire is still on the ground, so it will not spin.

props.text: Loosen the lug nuts first, while the tire is still on the ground.

beats.narration: Now place the jack at the spot your manual shows, under the frame near the flat. Raise the car until the flat tire is a few inches off the ground.
Never put any part of your body under the car while it is on the jack. A jack can slip, so keep your hands and head clear.
Remove the lug nuts completely and keep them together in a safe spot. Then pull the flat tire straight toward you and lay it flat on the ground.
Line up the spare with the wheel bolts and slide it on. Then thread the lug nuts back by hand, until they are snug.

steps.label: Line up the spare with the bolts

beats.narration: Lower the car until the tire touches the ground, then remove the jack. Tighten the lug nuts with the wrench, working in a star pattern so the wheel sits evenly.
Finally, store the flat and your tools. Check the spare's pressure soon, and drive carefully, since many spares are meant for short trips. Then get the flat repaired. You did it.
